meta.title: Daring Proposal
meta.description: When thinking and planning yield no fruit, sometimes inspiration strikes.

units.rawText: Null Area outside Zone G.
units.displayText: Null Area outside Zone G.

units.rawText: Watching as Sol ends her call, Antonina sighs.
units.displayText: Watching as Sol ends her call, Antonina sighs.

spans.text: Watching as Sol ends her call, Antonina sighs.

units.rawText: What is it, Anna? You won't grow tall if you keep sighing like that.
units.displayText: What is it, Anna? You won't grow tall if you keep sighing like that.

spans.text: What is it, Anna? You won't grow tall if you keep sighing like that.

units.rawText: Those two things aren't correlated...
units.displayText: Those two things aren't correlated...

spans.text: Those two things aren't correlated...

units.rawText: Do you really think we can deal with those Entropics in our current circumstances?
units.displayText: Do you really think we can deal with those Entropics in our current circumstances?

spans.text: Do you really think we can deal with those Entropics in our current circumstances?

units.rawText: Antonina turns around to look at the squad they had in tow. These agents had just surmounted a fierce confrontation in Rossum, and their travels directly afterwards had worn them down even further.
units.displayText: Antonina turns around to look at the squad they had in tow. These agents had just surmounted a fierce confrontation in Rossum, and their travels directly afterwards had worn them down even further.

spans.text: Antonina turns around to look at the squad they had in tow. These agents had just surmounted a fierce confrontation in Rossum, and their travels directly afterwards had worn them down even further.

units.rawText: With the little time they were allowed to rest, everyone was occupied with trying to restore their condition.
units.displayText: With the little time they were allowed to rest, everyone was occupied with trying to restore their condition.

spans.text: With the little time they were allowed to rest, everyone was occupied with trying to restore their condition.

units.rawText: The battle with Odile has left us spent. With the incapacitated agents remaining in Rossum to recover, we have very few combatants left.
units.displayText: The battle with Odile has left us spent. With the incapacitated agents remaining in Rossum to recover, we have very few combatants left.

spans.text: The battle with Odile has left us spent. With the incapacitated agents remaining in Rossum to recover, we have very few combatants left.

units.rawText: Hannah and Turing would have liked to assist, but Rossum has precious few combat agents to speak of in the first place, and they can barely take care of themselves...
units.displayText: Hannah and Turing would have liked to assist, but Rossum has precious few combat agents to speak of in the first place, and they can barely take care of themselves...

spans.text: Hannah and Turing would have liked to assist, but Rossum has precious few combat agents to speak of in the first place, and they can barely take care of themselves...

units.rawText: Ah, I remember now!
units.displayText: Ah, I remember now!

spans.text: Ah, I remember now!

units.rawText: What?! Don't be so jumpy.
units.displayText: What?! Don't be so jumpy.

spans.text: What?! Don't be so jumpy.

units.rawText: It's something like "sighing all the time sighs the happiness away", right? Sounds weird when I say it...
units.displayText: It's something like "sighing all the time sighs the happiness away", right? Sounds weird when I say it...

spans.text: It's something like "sighing all the time sighs the happiness away", right? Sounds weird when I say it...

units.rawText: ...I thought you had some sort of idea. Were you listening to me at all?
units.displayText: ...I thought you had some sort of idea. Were you listening to me at all?

spans.text: ...I thought you had some sort of idea. Were you listening to me at all?

units.rawText: Uwahhhh don't hit my head. I'm seriously thinking about it, I promise...
units.displayText: Uwahhhh don't hit my head. I'm seriously thinking about it, I promise...

spans.text: Uwahhhh don't hit my head. I'm seriously thinking about it, I promise...

units.rawText: Glimpsing at the hastily treated wounds on Sol's body, Antonina retracts her hand, conceding and shaking her head.
units.displayText: Glimpsing at the hastily treated wounds on Sol's body, Antonina retracts her hand, conceding and shaking her head.

spans.text: Glimpsing at the hastily treated wounds on Sol's body, Antonina retracts her hand, conceding and shaking her head.

units.rawText: What do you have in mind, then?
units.displayText: What do you have in mind, then?

spans.text: What do you have in mind, then?

units.rawText: Persicaria just said that the jellyfish is the one in charge, yeah? So, we go get rid of the jellyfish...
units.displayText: Persicaria just said that the jellyfish is the one in charge, yeah? So, we go get rid of the jellyfish...

spans.text: Persicaria just said that the jellyfish is the one in charge, yeah? So, we go get rid of the jellyfish...

units.rawText: And then?
units.displayText: And then?

spans.text: And then?

units.rawText: Uhh... there's no "and then", that was my idea... I'm serious! Stop hitting my head!
units.displayText: Uhh... there's no "and then", that was my idea... I'm serious! Stop hitting my head!

spans.text: Uhh... there's no "and then", that was my idea... I'm serious! Stop hitting my head!

units.rawText: What kind of plan is that?
units.displayText: What kind of plan is that?

spans.text: What kind of plan is that?

units.rawText: Sol cradles her head as if she was the victim of some great injustice as Antonina releases yet another sigh.
units.displayText: Sol cradles her head as if she was the victim of some great injustice as Antonina releases yet another sigh.

spans.text: Sol cradles her head as if she was the victim of some great injustice as Antonina releases yet another sigh.

units.rawText: Putting aside how we're supposed to defeat an elite Entropic we've never once seen before, even breaking through that blockade of Low Order Entropics is nigh impossible for us as it is.
units.displayText: Putting aside how we're supposed to defeat an elite Entropic we've never once seen before, even breaking through that blockade of Low Order Entropics is nigh impossible for us as it is.

spans.text: Putting aside how we're supposed to defeat an elite Entropic we've never once seen before, even breaking through that blockade of Low Order Entropics is nigh impossible for us as it is.

units.rawText: I figured as much. They should be focused on trying to crack the Oasis, right?
units.displayText: I figured as much. They should be focused on trying to crack the Oasis, right?

spans.text: I figured as much. They should be focused on trying to crack the Oasis, right?

units.rawText: So we'll sneak in from their rear and take their general's head!
units.displayText: So we'll sneak in from their rear and take their general's head!

spans.text: So we'll sneak in from their rear and take their general's head!

units.rawText: How do we sneak into the midst of that literal ocean of Entropics? How do we eliminate that Entropic we've never dealt with before in one strike?
units.displayText: How do we sneak into the midst of that literal ocean of Entropics? How do we eliminate that Entropic we've never dealt with before in one strike?

spans.text: How do we sneak into the midst of that literal ocean of Entropics? How do we eliminate that Entropic we've never dealt with before in one strike?

units.rawText: Even if we manage all of that, how are we supposed to handle said ocean of Entropics running wild after losing their controller?
units.displayText: Even if we manage all of that, how are we supposed to handle said ocean of Entropics running wild after losing their controller?

spans.text: Even if we manage all of that, how are we supposed to handle said ocean of Entropics running wild after losing their controller?

units.rawText: Don't you underestimate me! I've been studying up!
units.displayText: Don't you underestimate me! I've been studying up!

spans.text: Don't you underestimate me! I've been studying up!

units.rawText: I've run simulations just like you guys. My chances of escaping from the Entropics in a state of turmoil are approximately 0.37%!
units.displayText: I've run simulations just like you guys. My chances of escaping from the Entropics in a state of turmoil are approximately 0.37%!

spans.text: I've run simulations just like you guys. My chances of escaping from the Entropics in a state of turmoil are approximately 0.37%!

units.rawText: Stop it with these jokes!
units.displayText: Stop it with these jokes!

spans.text: Stop it with these jokes!

units.rawText: <size=28>0.37% still isn't 0%...</size>
units.displayText: 0.37% still isn't 0%...

spans.text: 0.37% still isn't 0%...

units.rawText: Antonina strides towards Sol at a brisk pace. As petit as her frame was in comparison, she commanded respect.
units.displayText: Antonina strides towards Sol at a brisk pace. As petit as her frame was in comparison, she commanded respect.

spans.text: Antonina strides towards Sol at a brisk pace. As petit as her frame was in comparison, she commanded respect.

units.rawText: Do you know how hard it was to get both you and Turing out alive? Now you're going to gamble it away charging in again?
units.displayText: Do you know how hard it was to get both you and Turing out alive? Now you're going to gamble it away charging in again?

spans.text: Do you know how hard it was to get both you and Turing out alive? Now you're going to gamble it away charging in again?

units.rawText: If Persicaria knew what was going on here, there's not a chance she'd let you do as you like!
units.displayText: If Persicaria knew what was going on here, there's not a chance she'd let you do as you like!

spans.text: If Persicaria knew what was going on here, there's not a chance she'd let you do as you like!

units.rawText: ...That's why we can't let her know.
units.displayText: ...That's why we can't let her know.

spans.text: ...That's why we can't let her know.

units.rawText: The smile slowly fades from Sol's face. She clutches the tiny bottle hanging before her chest, the bright verdure inside seemingly perpetual.
units.displayText: The smile slowly fades from Sol's face. She clutches the tiny bottle hanging before her chest, the bright verdure inside seemingly perpetual.

spans.text: The smile slowly fades from Sol's face. She clutches the tiny bottle hanging before her chest, the bright verdure inside seemingly perpetual.

units.rawText: Persicaria needs someone to prop her up right now. I'm here, so I'll be that someone.
units.displayText: Persicaria needs someone to prop her up right now. I'm here, so I'll be that someone.

spans.text: Persicaria needs someone to prop her up right now. I'm here, so I'll be that someone.

units.rawText: ...Why not ask Persicaria if she has any ideas? Neither of us are the Professor. We don't have that force of character for these extreme situations.
units.displayText: ...Why not ask Persicaria if she has any ideas? Neither of us are the Professor. We don't have that force of character for these extreme situations.

spans.text: ...Why not ask Persicaria if she has any ideas? Neither of us are the Professor. We don't have that force of character for these extreme situations.

units.rawText: I think I understand what Persicaria meant. If she wasn't truly pushed to the degree of having not a single option left, she'd never show anyone that expression.
units.displayText: I think I understand what Persicaria meant. If she wasn't truly pushed to the degree of having not a single option left, she'd never show anyone that expression.

spans.text: I think I understand what Persicaria meant. If she wasn't truly pushed to the degree of having not a single option left, she'd never show anyone that expression.

units.rawText: It's been a long road for... all of this. For Persicaria to open up, stop pushing people away, and really call the Oasis her home. For us to find all the companions we have...
units.displayText: It's been a long road for... all of this. For Persicaria to open up, stop pushing people away, and really call the Oasis her home. For us to find all the companions we have...

spans.text: It's been a long road for... all of this. For Persicaria to open up, stop pushing people away, and really call the Oasis her home. For us to find all the companions we have...

units.rawText: I can't stand and watch as she shoulders all of this... I promised.
units.displayText: I can't stand and watch as she shoulders all of this... I promised.

spans.text: I can't stand and watch as she shoulders all of this... I promised.

units.rawText: A resolute spark ignites in Sol's eyes, and Antonina can only gaze into a window of a memory she never shared.
units.displayText: A resolute spark ignites in Sol's eyes, and Antonina can only gaze into a window of a memory she never shared.

spans.text: A resolute spark ignites in Sol's eyes, and Antonina can only gaze into a window of a memory she never shared.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Beeeeeeep—notification sounds appear in unison, breaking the air of cumbersomeness between the two.
units.displayText: Beeeeeeep—notification sounds appear in unison, breaking the air of cumbersomeness between the two.

spans.text: Beeeeeeep—notification sounds appear in unison, breaking the air of cumbersomeness between the two.

units.rawText: Huh? A message from Persicaria? This is...
units.displayText: Huh? A message from Persicaria? This is...

spans.text: Huh? A message from Persicaria? This is...

units.rawText: ...Data from the analysis of the jellyfish.
units.displayText: ...Data from the analysis of the jellyfish.

spans.text: ...Data from the analysis of the jellyfish.

units.rawText: Ohhhh. Man, that sure is a lotta numbers; it looks messed up...
units.displayText: Ohhhh. Man, that sure is a lotta numbers; it looks messed up...

spans.text: Ohhhh. Man, that sure is a lotta numbers; it looks messed up...

units.rawText: Antonina quickly peruses the contents of the message. She took a deep breath, slowly exhaling.
units.displayText: Antonina quickly peruses the contents of the message. She took a deep breath, slowly exhaling.

spans.text: Antonina quickly peruses the contents of the message. She took a deep breath, slowly exhaling.

units.rawText: ...Okay. I'll help you.
units.displayText: ...Okay. I'll help you.

spans.text: ...Okay. I'll help you.

units.rawText: Eh? You're already done, Anna? ...No, wait, have you had a change of heart?
units.displayText: Eh? You're already done, Anna? ...No, wait, have you had a change of heart?

spans.text: Eh? You're already done, Anna? ...No, wait, have you had a change of heart?

units.rawText: I do not agree with your methods, but I do know how stubborn you are. Rather than let you go execute a doomed plan, it'd be better to help you improve your odds.
units.displayText: I do not agree with your methods, but I do know how stubborn you are. Rather than let you go execute a doomed plan, it'd be better to help you improve your odds.

spans.text: I do not agree with your methods, but I do know how stubborn you are. Rather than let you go execute a doomed plan, it'd be better to help you improve your odds.

units.rawText: And according to the data Persicaria has provided, it might not be impossible to eliminate our target quickly.
units.displayText: And according to the data Persicaria has provided, it might not be impossible to eliminate our target quickly.

spans.text: And according to the data Persicaria has provided, it might not be impossible to eliminate our target quickly.

units.rawText: Yay!
units.displayText: Yay!

spans.text: Yay!

units.rawText: Don't start cheering just yet. If you want to fulfill that promise of yours, you'd better listen to me well.
units.displayText: Don't start cheering just yet. If you want to fulfill that promise of yours, you'd better listen to me well.

spans.text: Don't start cheering just yet. If you want to fulfill that promise of yours, you'd better listen to me well.

units.rawText: I'll come back in one piece. Promise.
units.displayText: I'll come back in one piece. Promise.

spans.text: I'll come back in one piece. Promise.

units.rawText: Antonina tolerates Sol's patting of her head, her hands already working away at her keyboard—a sign that she's entering performance mode.
units.displayText: Antonina tolerates Sol's patting of her head, her hands already working away at her keyboard—a sign that she's entering performance mode.

spans.text: Antonina tolerates Sol's patting of her head, her hands already working away at her keyboard—a sign that she's entering performance mode.

units.rawText: Let's sort out this mess first.
units.displayText: Let's sort out this mess first.

spans.text: Let's sort out this mess first.

units.rawText: Antonina points at the map, the symbols of different factions plotted out on it.
units.displayText: Antonina points at the map, the symbols of different factions plotted out on it.

spans.text: Antonina points at the map, the symbols of different factions plotted out on it.

units.rawText: Before Eucharist fired the railgun, the Professor asked the Guardians to reinforce the Oasis. This means that we will receive combat reinforcements in the near future.
units.displayText: Before Eucharist fired the railgun, the Professor asked the Guardians to reinforce the Oasis. This means that we will receive combat reinforcements in the near future.

spans.text: Before Eucharist fired the railgun, the Professor asked the Guardians to reinforce the Oasis. This means that we will receive combat reinforcements in the near future.

units.rawText: So when the Guardians get here, we won't have to worry about that side of things?
units.displayText: So when the Guardians get here, we won't have to worry about that side of things?

spans.text: So when the Guardians get here, we won't have to worry about that side of things?

units.rawText: Yes. As far away as they are, it still comes as a relief to everyone.
units.displayText: Yes. As far away as they are, it still comes as a relief to everyone.

spans.text: Yes. As far away as they are, it still comes as a relief to everyone.

units.rawText: Secondly... a portion of the agents in our detail were previously on the team responsible for the railgun's repairs, led by Hannah and Croque. They didn't have any particularly fierce battles and still have some left in them.
units.displayText: Secondly... a portion of the agents in our detail were previously on the team responsible for the railgun's repairs, led by Hannah and Croque. They didn't have any particularly fierce battles and still have some left in them.

spans.text: Secondly... a portion of the agents in our detail were previously on the team responsible for the railgun's repairs, led by Hannah and Croque. They didn't have any particularly fierce battles and still have some left in them.

units.rawText: With these agents as the core, we should be able to structure a competent attack.
units.displayText: With these agents as the core, we should be able to structure a competent attack.

spans.text: With these agents as the core, we should be able to structure a competent attack.

units.rawText: Speaking of, is it really okay for Croque to move by herself?
units.displayText: Speaking of, is it really okay for Croque to move by herself?

spans.text: Speaking of, is it really okay for Croque to move by herself?

units.rawText: Yeah, she isn't there to pick fights.
units.displayText: Yeah, she isn't there to pick fights.

spans.text: Yeah, she isn't there to pick fights.

units.rawText: Captain Anna, the reconnaissance squad has sent word!
units.displayText: Captain Anna, the reconnaissance squad has sent word!

spans.text: Captain Anna, the reconnaissance squad has sent word!

units.rawText: Huh? You sent people off to scout?
units.displayText: Huh? You sent people off to scout?

spans.text: Huh? You sent people off to scout?

units.rawText: Did you seriously think this is actually time to rest? In times of need, every minute is precious.
units.displayText: Did you seriously think this is actually time to rest? In times of need, every minute is precious.

spans.text: Did you seriously think this is actually time to rest? In times of need, every minute is precious.

units.rawText: "If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles." Like the Professor said.
units.displayText: "If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles." Like the Professor said.

spans.text: "If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles." Like the Professor said.

units.rawText: You squabble with the Professor all day, but you seem to remember what they say well enough... okay, okay, stop giving me that look! Just... go on with what you were saying.
units.displayText: You squabble with the Professor all day, but you seem to remember what they say well enough... okay, okay, stop giving me that look! Just... go on with what you were saying.

spans.text: You squabble with the Professor all day, but you seem to remember what they say well enough... okay, okay, stop giving me that look! Just... go on with what you were saying.

units.rawText: What are the scouts' conclusions?
units.displayText: What are the scouts' conclusions?

spans.text: What are the scouts' conclusions?

units.rawText: The Low-Orders have the unknown Entropic protected well, and we struggled to approach.
units.displayText: The Low-Orders have the unknown Entropic protected well, and we struggled to approach.

spans.text: The Low-Orders have the unknown Entropic protected well, and we struggled to approach.

units.rawText: The good news is that they are focused on the attack on the Oasis, as Captain Sol said. They haven't detected our presence yet.
units.displayText: The good news is that they are focused on the attack on the Oasis, as Captain Sol said. They haven't detected our presence yet.

spans.text: The good news is that they are focused on the attack on the Oasis, as Captain Sol said. They haven't detected our presence yet.

units.rawText: I see... with this potent of a defense, how'll we get access to their leader?
units.displayText: I see... with this potent of a defense, how'll we get access to their leader?

spans.text: I see... with this potent of a defense, how'll we get access to their leader?

units.rawText: Antonina stares at the photo of the Entropic horde, seemingly infinite layers thick, at her wit's end.
units.displayText: Antonina stares at the photo of the Entropic horde, seemingly infinite layers thick, at her wit's end.

spans.text: Antonina stares at the photo of the Entropic horde, seemingly infinite layers thick, at her wit's end.

units.rawText: Didn't Persicaria put in the report that this thing likes to eat operands?
units.displayText: Didn't Persicaria put in the report that this thing likes to eat operands?

spans.text: Didn't Persicaria put in the report that this thing likes to eat operands?

units.rawText: They already lost interest in Mai's balloon, most likely because attacking the Oasis is a higher priority directive. If that objective is not completed, it's unlikely for them to switch targets.
units.displayText: They already lost interest in Mai's balloon, most likely because attacking the Oasis is a higher priority directive. If that objective is not completed, it's unlikely for them to switch targets.

spans.text: They already lost interest in Mai's balloon, most likely because attacking the Oasis is a higher priority directive. If that objective is not completed, it's unlikely for them to switch targets.

units.rawText: Huh? I remember the Oasis was in that general direction, so those Entropics should be there as well.
units.displayText: Huh? I remember the Oasis was in that general direction, so those Entropics should be there as well.

spans.text: Huh? I remember the Oasis was in that general direction, so those Entropics should be there as well.

units.rawText: With how big that group of Entropics looks in the photos, why can't we see them here?
units.displayText: With how big that group of Entropics looks in the photos, why can't we see them here?

spans.text: With how big that group of Entropics looks in the photos, why can't we see them here?

units.rawText: Ah, Captain Sol, that's because the Entropic liquid began to terraform the area after solidifying. The Entropic swarm is concealed by higher ground in all directions.
units.displayText: Ah, Captain Sol, that's because the Entropic liquid began to terraform the area after solidifying. The Entropic swarm is concealed by higher ground in all directions.

spans.text: Ah, Captain Sol, that's because the Entropic liquid began to terraform the area after solidifying. The Entropic swarm is concealed by higher ground in all directions.

units.rawText: ...Wait, they're surrounded by higher ground?
units.displayText: ...Wait, they're surrounded by higher ground?

spans.text: ...Wait, they're surrounded by higher ground?

units.rawText: Yes. The topography of the area is quite complex, and it's possible that the Entropics used this to avoid Sanctifier searches in the Null Areas...
units.displayText: Yes. The topography of the area is quite complex, and it's possible that the Entropics used this to avoid Sanctifier searches in the Null Areas...

spans.text: Yes. The topography of the area is quite complex, and it's possible that the Entropics used this to avoid Sanctifier searches in the Null Areas...

units.rawText: That could be an angle of approach, Sol.
units.displayText: That could be an angle of approach, Sol.

spans.text: That could be an angle of approach, Sol.

units.rawText: Got it. I'll be back in a jiffy with this little guy here.
units.displayText: Got it. I'll be back in a jiffy with this little guy here.

spans.text: Got it. I'll be back in a jiffy with this little guy here.

units.rawText: Slinging an arm over the agent's shoulder, Sol grins from ear to ear, and she flashes Antonina a v-sign. Antonina nods, leaving the agent giving the report in a state of confusion.
units.displayText: Slinging an arm over the agent's shoulder, Sol grins from ear to ear, and she flashes Antonina a v-sign. Antonina nods, leaving the agent giving the report in a state of confusion.

spans.text: Slinging an arm over the agent's shoulder, Sol grins from ear to ear, and she flashes Antonina a v-sign. Antonina nods, leaving the agent giving the report in a state of confusion.

units.rawText: W...what? Where are you going?
units.displayText: W...what? Where are you going?

spans.text: W...what? Where are you going?

units.rawText: Going to see that "high ground" you were talking about, that's where. If we can use that to our advantage, maybe we can show 'em a little "justice from above"!
units.displayText: Going to see that "high ground" you were talking about, that's where. If we can use that to our advantage, maybe we can show 'em a little "justice from above"!

spans.text: Going to see that "high ground" you were talking about, that's where. If we can use that to our advantage, maybe we can show 'em a little "justice from above"!

units.rawText: Give me the topographic data. I'll put together an exact plan.
units.displayText: Give me the topographic data. I'll put together an exact plan.

spans.text: Give me the topographic data. I'll put together an exact plan.

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: Wait.
units.displayText: Wait.

spans.text: Wait.

units.rawText: With the agent in her clutches, Sol began to make off, but a sudden call from Antonina turned her around.
units.displayText: With the agent in her clutches, Sol began to make off, but a sudden call from Antonina turned her around.

spans.text: With the agent in her clutches, Sol began to make off, but a sudden call from Antonina turned her around.

units.rawText: What, any other commands, Anna-sensei?
units.displayText: What, any other commands, Anna-sensei?

spans.text: What, any other commands, Anna-sensei?

units.rawText: ...Persicaria said that we would all go back to reality together, right?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria said that we would all go back to reality together, right?

spans.text: ...Persicaria said that we would all go back to reality together, right?

units.rawText: Yeah.
units.displayText: Yeah.

spans.text: Yeah.

units.rawText: Sol solemnly nods.
units.displayText: Sol solemnly nods.

spans.text: Sol solemnly nods.

units.rawText: When I was heading expedition teams, we'd run into danger frequently as well.
units.displayText: When I was heading expedition teams, we'd run into danger frequently as well.

spans.text: When I was heading expedition teams, we'd run into danger frequently as well.

units.rawText: I contemplated "death" back then... even if it is a bit weird for a Doll. One thing led to another, and I thought that if I were to "die", I'd like to be at home, with friends at my side. That way, it wouldn't be so bleak.
units.displayText: I contemplated "death" back then... even if it is a bit weird for a Doll. One thing led to another, and I thought that if I were to "die", I'd like to be at home, with friends at my side. That way, it wouldn't be so bleak.

spans.text: I contemplated "death" back then... even if it is a bit weird for a Doll. One thing led to another, and I thought that if I were to "die", I'd like to be at home, with friends at my side. That way, it wouldn't be so bleak.

units.rawText: That belief is why I've held out until now.
units.displayText: That belief is why I've held out until now.

spans.text: That belief is why I've held out until now.

units.rawText: ...Never imagined that you would have contemplated that.
units.displayText: ...Never imagined that you would have contemplated that.

spans.text: ...Never imagined that you would have contemplated that.

units.rawText: Like I said, I've been studying up!
units.displayText: Like I said, I've been studying up!

spans.text: Like I said, I've been studying up!
